dct_description_sm: Polygon Feature Class of the locations of boat docks (Private/Public) within the City of Kingston, The Polygon represents the actual physical structure of the dock. Although not attributed as such this feature includes all types of docks from single private docks to large public marina docks. Most of the docks are permanent in nature. This data is updated with the most recent Imagery (Nearmap) acquisition (Spring/Fall).
